description: This file defines the SearchFormController class, which manages the display logic for a search form in the SuiteCRM project. It extends a base Controller class and interacts with SearchQuery and SearchWrapper to prepare data for rendering the search form template.

classes.name: SearchFormController
classes.description: Controller class managing the search form UI in SuiteCRM, handling display logic and integrating search query data into the view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchFormController with a SearchQuery object and calls the parent constructor with a new SearchFormView.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares data related to the search query and modules, assigns them to the view, and calls the parent display method to render the form.
